resources.string: Make icons and your desktop your own, one step at a time.
Enable KeiHome in LSPosed and grant host scopes. You can continue and finish this later.
Choose artwork, preview the result, then generate and apply. Downloading or previewing does not apply a theme.
Explore Dock materials, appearance and text, or icons and launching. Choose what suits you.
Finish any pending steps later. Revisit this guide anytime in Settings.
Check host permissions and versions. A grant does not confirm loading.
One system reboot is recommended after first enabling. Later updates normally hot reload; a newly authorized host may need its next process start.
Connection and grants do not confirm every host is loaded. Check icons on the launcher, share sheet, Settings or Sidebar you use. For hook issues, use LSPosed logs; for app issues, use app logs.
Enable the module and manage its scopes
Adjust what you need, then check each category’s status. Search bar material can follow Dock or be set independently.
